title: Garlic Zucchini Noodles (Zoodles)
summary: Peel and mince garlic, spiralize zucchini, then sauté the zoodles briefly with garlic and oil in a skillet and season to serve.
source: open-set draft from 8 frames + the person's description 'making Zoodles'

nodes.name: Separate garlic cloves from bulb
nodes.instruction_novice: Press on the garlic bulb to break it apart. Pull off two or three cloves.
nodes.end_state: A few loose garlic cloves sit on the counter beside the bulb.

checks.question: Is this step done: Separate garlic cloves from bulb?

nodes.name: Peel the garlic cloves
nodes.instruction_novice: Trim the root end and peel off the papery skin with your fingers. Smashing it lightly with a knife makes this easier.
nodes.end_state: Clean white peeled cloves with skins piled to the side.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the garlic cloves?

nodes.name: Mince the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Chop the peeled cloves into very small pieces on a cutting board. Keep your fingertips curled away from the blade.
nodes.end_state: A small pile of finely minced garlic is on the cutting board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mince the garlic?

nodes.name: Wash and trim the zucchini
nodes.instruction_novice: Rinse the zucchini under water and pat dry. Cut off both ends.
nodes.end_state: Clean zucchini with both ends cut off lie on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Wash and trim the zucchini?

nodes.name: Spiralize zucchini into noodles
nodes.instruction_novice: Secure the zucchini in the spiralizer and turn the handle to make long noodles. Work steadily and watch your fingers near the blade.
nodes.end_state: A bowl holds a pile of long zucchini spirals.

checks.question: Is this step done: Spiralize zucchini into noodles?

nodes.name: Pat zoodles dry
nodes.instruction_novice: Lay the noodles on a paper towel and gently press to remove excess water. This keeps them from getting soggy.
nodes.end_state: Zoodles rest on damp paper towels, looking drier.

checks.question: Is this step done: Pat zoodles dry?

nodes.name: Heat oil in the skillet
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the pan on medium heat and add about a tablespoon of oil. Wait until the oil shimmers.
nodes.end_state: Oil shimmers in the pan on the lit burner.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat oil in the skillet?

nodes.name: Sauté the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the minced garlic and stir for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant. Don't let it brown.
nodes.end_state: Garlic sizzles in the oil, pale golden.

checks.question: Is this step done: Sauté the garlic?

nodes.name: Cook the zoodles
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the zucchini noodles and toss them with tongs. Cook just 2 to 3 minutes until slightly tender.
nodes.end_state: Zoodles in the pan are glossy and just softened.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cook the zoodles?

nodes.name: Season to taste
nodes.instruction_novice: Sprinkle with salt and pepper, and add any extras like parmesan or chili flakes. Toss to combine.
nodes.end_state: Seasonings are visibly mixed through the zoodles.

checks.question: Is this step done: Season to taste?

nodes.name: Turn off heat and plate
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn off the burner and move the zoodles to a plate. Serve right away.
nodes.end_state: Zoodles are on a plate and the burner is off.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off heat and plate?
